scope: Manual comparison of all 166 live O contracts to registered recipe implementations; not full method/source fidelity certification.

contract.inputs: C03 file inventory/schema, frozen required input list, exact requested event intervals, source/instrument identity, coverage and missingness records.
contract.outputs: coverage_ok:boolean?, base_identity_ok:boolean?, missing_intervals[], missing_fields[], source_precision, available_depth.
contract.timing: At the relevant observation cutoff after all required records are validated; a later file audit can validate coverage but cannot move a market value's own known_at earlier.

review.note: Counts the first required_minutes rows and complete flags; no exact interval union, instrument/field ownership or native-depth coverage result. Missing price coverage is marked base false rather than a required-data unknown.

objects.title: Touch, reject, hold and break measurements

contract.inputs: Frozen band [lo, hi], parent width W when used, known_at, source side, exact price/bar evidence, explicitly supplied tolerance and hold/rejection criteria.
contract.outputs: contact_at, price_overlap:boolean?, strict_break_side, sweep_depth, literal_close_return:boolean?, source_reject:boolean?, source_hold:boolean?.
contract.timing: Contact at the witnessed event; bar overlap/close at bar close; a hold/rejection only when its complete stated evidence is available.

review.note: Only bar overlap, upper excursion and upper close-return geometry are emitted. Tick contact/time, lower-side measurements and configured tolerance/hold evaluation are absent; missing H yields upper excursion 0. Default q=0.25 is not instrument provenance.

contract.inputs: Source timezone/clock/version, dated interval endpoints, native timestamp profile, instrument and complete bar/event membership.
contract.outputs: start_ns, end_ns, session_date_et, bar_close_at, window_known_at, clock_verified.
contract.timing: Completed window at end; completed bar at close; source clock verification is an input, not a guess from a label.

review.note: Availability comparison exists, but source clock verification defaults true; no date/session output or positive interval validation in this recipe. Robust ET helpers elsewhere are not used here.

contract.inputs: C03 executed events or complete finer OHLCV; source bar kind/size/anchor, instrument and member IDs.
contract.outputs: bar_id, O, H, L, C, V, start, end, complete, known_at, native_source_compatible.
contract.timing: Completed bar at final required event/close, developing native candle snapshot only at its as_of event.

review.note: Always reports complete/native-compatible true for time input, even when aggregate_ohlcv returns incomplete or empty. Does not enforce expected clock membership/instrument or emit bar identity/bounds. Native range is an unconditional hole even if a source-compatible supplied construction is present.

contract.inputs: Complete source-compatible prices/bars for [06:00, 09:00) ET on one contract/date.
contract.outputs: range_id, L, H, W, formation_start, formation_end, range_known_at, range_frozen.
contract.timing: 09:00 ET after included bars close; q and identity must already be verified.

review.note: H/L freezing and half-open membership exist, but range_hl never proves absence of missing minutes; the semantic 06–09 source clock and range identity are not constructed here.

contract.inputs: Source version plus exactly selected dated formation; same H/L inputs as 6–9.
contract.outputs: source_clock_id, range_id, L, H, W, known_at, source_clock_verified.
contract.timing: At each chosen formation end; later London configuration requires its own verified endpoints.

review.note: Works from supplied H/L; missing source_clock_verified is promoted to true. No raw range construction or source clock inventory binding.

contract.inputs: Frozen parent range_id, L, H, W>0 and known_at.
contract.outputs: q25=L+0.25W, eq=L+0.50W, q75=L+0.75W, all with parent ID.
contract.timing: Parent range known_at.

review.note: Exact q25/EQ/q75 algebra, positive width and optional parent ID are present. Upstream immutable parent/coverage still must be supplied.

contract.inputs: Literal source label, parent range/version, source price/band, anchor event or verified open/close rule, source time and known_at.
contract.outputs: range_open_ref, range_close_ref, anchor_id, reference_verified, directed_path.
contract.timing: Actual anchor availability or supplied pre-use snapshot; unresolved time => null.

review.note: Only range-open reference is supported; range-close and anchor identity are absent. The replace_with_first_print flag knowingly substitutes a different reference while leaving reference_verified true.

contract.inputs: Own W; explicit positive denominator price P and its timestamp or separate prior_range_width; source bucket/definition if supplied.
contract.outputs: width_points, width_ticks=W/q, price_percent=100W/P, width_ratio=W/prior_W, source_width_class:boolean/enum?.
contract.timing: Maximum of own and comparison input known_at.

review.note: Distinct width/price-percent/prior-width ratios exist with a supplied class. Needs upstream denominator/known-at provenance and positive-unit checks; no automatic width-class engine is claimed.

contract.inputs: Frozen L/H, explicit later outcome window, source break definition, ordered post-formation prices.
contract.outputs: high_break_at, low_break_at, path=high_only/low_only/both/neither/unknown, first_side, eq_return_at.
contract.timing: Final path at declared outcome-window end; prefix observations only at their actual event time.

review.note: First breaches and path prefixes exist. EQ-return output is missing, completed-time equality is used as the default coverage proof, and the single-bar path branch handles only both-side case fully.

contract.inputs: Source overnight start/end, contract, complete prices, separately named Asia/London window IDs.
contract.outputs: on_high, on_low, on_width, window_id, known_at; separate Asia/London records.
contract.timing: At selected overnight window end; developing prefix has a different object ID/state.

review.note: Already documents Sires 18:00–09:30 clock. Recipe audits supplied H/L/end rather than constructing the overnight range from complete native observations; auto window ID does not prove source identity.

contract.inputs: Reference ID/price/side, formation known_at, source consumption scope and sweep definition, chronological event stream.
contract.outputs: active_before_use, purged_at, consumption_scope, purge_known_at, source_purged_context?.
contract.timing: At first qualifying sweep event/confirmation; not when two completed ranges are compared later.

review.note: Checks one supplied sweep time rather than maintains a reference-event ledger. RTH-only scope always stays active, including a qualifying RTH sweep; source sweep definition and first-event discovery are absent.

contract.inputs: Observed cash-open price/time; prior fixed value [VAL, VAH] and prior price [L, H]; today's already-frozen range; optional source RVOL record.
contract.outputs: open_vs_value=below/inside/above/on_boundary, open_vs_range, open_vs_current_range, opening_context?, rvol_known_at.
contract.timing: Maximum opening-event and reference availability; RVOL measured 09:30–09:35 adds known_at09:35.

review.note: Inclusive inside booleans collapse the contract's exact-boundary state; below/above/full current range cell outputs and dated opening/profile joins are missing.

contract.inputs: Frozen range_id, L, H, W; exact source ladder coordinate convention and selected band; price events.
contract.outputs: upper_k=H+k W, lower_k=L-k W, selected_band, sweep_depth_points, sweep_depth_W, touch_at.
contract.timing: Parent geometry and source band selection must be known before use; contact at its event/complete bar.

review.note: Upper ladder only, no lower ladder or touch event. Sweep depth is not clamped at zero and no positive width validation occurs.

contract.inputs: Source-selected parent span L/H/W and verified beyond-edge coordinate convention.
contract.outputs: upper_band=[H+1.33W, H+1.66W], lower_band=[L-1.66W, L-1.33W], parent_id, known_at.
contract.timing: Maximum parent geometry and source coordinate-selection time, before touch.

review.note: Normal 1.33/1.66 algebra is correct and source chart checked earlier. use_outer_w explicitly substitutes outer width for inner parent without marking invalid; zero/reversed widths and coordinate provenance need enforcement.

contract.inputs: Source outer and inner IDs/bounds, literal labels/version, supplied span creation/known_at and projection parent.
contract.outputs: outer_width, inner_width, parent_binding, inner_geometry_known?, automatic_inner_span=null.
contract.timing: Supplied pre-use snapshot time; retrospective drawing is source-illustration evidence only.

review.note: Supplied inner/outer widths and midpoints exist. Parent-binding output, label preservation, positive widths and construction-hole reason when bounds are supplied are incomplete.

contract.inputs: Versioned source session/reset/lookback/settings, labeled average/median/min-average bands and their snapshot time.
contract.outputs: average_hi/lo, median_hi/lo, min_average_hi/lo, midpoint_when_labeled, source_band_known?, automatic_bands=null.
contract.timing: Snapshot availability before the tested touch; later calculated session extrema are not prerequisites.

review.note: Properly avoids rebuilding SessionStat, but supplied endpoint ordering, separately typed min-average outputs, source settings/known-at and conditional labeled-midpoint handling are incomplete.

contract.inputs: Literal EVRange band/midpoint values, source date/version/anchor and verified known_at.
contract.outputs: ev_low, ev_high, ev_mid_if_supplied, ev_reference_known?, automatic_ev=null.
contract.timing: Verified source snapshot time before candidate use, otherwise unknown/source illustration.

review.note: Avoids automatic EV, but only accepts a midpoint; EV low/high and full source snapshot contract are not carried through.

contract.inputs: Literal P-zone bounds, anchor, source settings/version, known_at, supplied active/invalidation history and directed source/target IDs.
contract.outputs: pzone_id, lo, hi, anchor_at, source_zone_known?, active_at_use?, directed_path_recorded.
contract.timing: Actual source snapshot availability; anchor time alone does not prove known_at or fill_at.

review.note: Supplied P-zone bounds/time work; active/invalidation history and zone identity outputs are absent. Directed path flag checks IDs only, not the chronological observed path.

contract.inputs: Prior 09:30–16:00ET prices, M15/H1 source imbalance IDs/bounds, current pre-entry direction record, source consumption scope.
contract.outputs: prior_rth_high/low, known_at, rth_active_objectives[], chosen_draw?, current_direction?.
contract.timing: Prior range at 16:00; imbalance at its defining confirmation; direction only when observed before decision.

review.note: Prior RTH H/L accepted as inputs; complete prior-range builder, HTF imbalance association and RTH-only active-objective ledger are absent.

contract.inputs: Method branch, exact source action interval/purpose, sweep/confirmation/decision/exit events; any supplied source delay.
contract.outputs: at_rth_open, source_time_window:boolean?, exit_window_recorded, actual_action_at.
contract.timing: Window instruction before decision; actual confirmation/exit when it happens.

review.note: Window comparison exists, but unspecified windows default to a fixed synthetic January 15, 2026 date. Entry/reversal/exit purpose and start-boundary ambiguity are not represented.

contract.inputs: Author/date, selected session/version, reason for cleaner-session preference, evidence interval and known_at.
contract.outputs: source_cleanliness_label, session_selected_before_use, automatic_cleanliness=null.
contract.timing: When that judgment was recorded before the selected session/decision.

review.note: Causal supplied cleanliness judgment supported, but actual label is discarded and every timely non-null label maps source_clean=true, even an explicitly unclean label.

contract.inputs: Parent range/branch, supplied phase names, transition evidence keys and contemporaneous versus retrospective flag.
contract.outputs: phase_label, phase_known_at, used_as_context:boolean, automatic_phase=null.
contract.timing: At actual evidence/annotation time; not at the earlier bar named after the fact.

review.note: Checks distribution availability; phase label/transition sequence and context-use fields are only partly represented. No automatic detector is correctly claimed.

objects.title: Jumbo failure signatures and three attempts

contract.inputs: Same source level/branch, distinct admitted attempt/exit IDs, outcome and timing; continuing-through evidence; original and subsequent allocation.
contract.outputs: failed_attempt_count, three_failed_attempts, reversal_invalidated?, later_allocation_ok?.
contract.timing: At third completed failure or other observed source invalidation; allocation check at later allocation decision.

review.note: Counts distinct IDs without filtering failed outcomes or same level/branch, so it does not compute three failed attempts. New allocation compliance and invalidation state are absent.

contract.inputs: Source opening-range start/end/version, complete H/L, distinct parent ID and known_at.
contract.outputs: or_mid=(or_high+or_low)/2, or_known, subsequent_mid_retrace.
contract.timing: OR end after complete data; source clock unknown meansor_known=null.

review.note: Computes midpoint from H/L and an end time. Source OR start/configuration, complete construction and later contact are absent; automatic_or=true overstates supplied scalar support.

contract.inputs: Source swing high/low IDs and prices, price times, confirmation times, source chart timeframe.
contract.outputs: swing_mid=(high+low)/2, swing_known_at, later_mid_contact.
contract.timing: Maximum endpoint confirmation time, not the earlier pivot's timestamp.

review.note: Midpoint uses maximum endpoint confirmation time and checks a supplied later touch; automatic pivot is null. Raw swing selection/identity must remain explicit.

contract.inputs: Current completed source volume window, explicit prior comparison sessions with same clock and their volumes, baseline statistic/configuration.
contract.outputs: current_volume, baseline_volume, rvol=current/baseline, source_high_rvol?.
contract.timing: Maximum baseline and current window-end availability; never cash-open if window ends later.

review.note: Divides current total by supplied baseline and checks current window end. Same-clock prior sample aggregation, sample IDs, baseline availability and positive baseline checks are absent.

contract.inputs: Source reference point IDs/prices/times, chosen equality criterion/tolerance, objective band and pre-entry selection.
contract.outputs: equal_reference_band, contributors[], reference_known, remaining_objective?.
contract.timing: Maximum contributor confirmation and source selection time.

review.note: Exact two-price equality and containment in a supplied band work. Contributor identities/confirmation, objective selection and remaining-state assembly are external.

contract.inputs: Calendar event ID, scheduled ET time/timezone, schedule publication key; actual release key, vintage/value if supplied; source thesis/target response and decision key.
contract.outputs: schedule_known, release_known, new_information_known, source_response?, thesis_revision_id?.
contract.timing: Schedule at publication; release at actual availability; response at its observed source decision.

review.note: Schedule/release/revision availability comparisons exist, but full event/vintage/response ledger and thesis revision association are not assembled.

contract.inputs: Instrument, source reset key and anchor convention; canonical executed trades price p_i and size v_i, source weighting basis, as_of key.
contract.outputs: sum_v, sum_pv, vwap=sum_pv/sum_v, reset_id, basis, as_of, known_at.
contract.timing: As_of after all included events are available; a band frozen for a touch uses only records before that touch (strictly earlier key unless source explicitly includes the contact trade).

review.note: Trade-price VWAP has explicit reset/tape/instrument checks, exact weighted arithmetic and pre-contact gating. It only supports trade_price; the Sires HLC3 platform configuration requires a separately specified bar-basis implementation. Complete interval proof remains external.

contract.inputs: Anchor event/swing ID, anchor price time, confirmation/selection key and source reason; weighting convention; executed events after anchor; evaluation key.
contract.outputs: anchor_id, anchor_price_at, anchor_known_at, avwap, as_of, usable_at.
contract.timing: max(anchor confirmation, source selection, latest included input availability); no use before anchor was known.

review.note: Anchored VWAP sets known_at/usable_at to anchor confirmation even when later trades contribute to the value. It does not inherit the stronger O030 tape/ownership/coverage checks or use max input availability.

contract.inputs: Parent VWAP snapshot μ, supplied/source-defined standard deviation σ with weighting convention, selected multiplier k and band side, availability.
contract.outputs: upper=μ+kσ, lower=μ-kσ, band_id, variance_convention, as_of.
contract.timing: Maximum parent and deviation snapshot availability before contact.

review.note: Supplied sigma convention and nonnegative sigma gate exact mu±k sigma. Full band identity and parent snapshot assembly remain external; source platform settings need a configuration record.

contract.inputs: Native product, expiry cohort, source regime/sign interpretation and snapshot time; branch ID; uncertainty/reread record.
contract.outputs: source_regime:short_gamma/long_gamma/uncertain/null, branch_regime_ok?, native_identity_ok, reread_at?.
contract.timing: Actual snapshot availability, not request date or final OI.

review.note: Supplied short/long/uncertain regime preserves the two BIG branch permissions and leaves the undisclosed engine null. Native 0DTE identity must be joined separately.

contract.inputs: symbol, option class, expiration, strike, right, osi_symbol; observation ET date and source snapshot times; OI/volume/Greek provenance and explicit mapping if any.
contract.outputs: native_contract_key, is_0dte, native_strike, source_product_ok, mapped_price? with mapping provenance.
contract.timing: Each required record's true availability; OI request_date is insufficient.

review.note: Only supplied expiry/date equality and symbol/strike comparison are performed. Full native option contract key, source-time normalization and documented mapping provenance are not produced.

contract.inputs: Literal flip label/value, product/expiry, source sign convention, native spot, snapshot and uncertainty.
contract.outputs: flip_value, spot_minus_flip, relation:below/on/above, source_regime_interpretation?.
contract.timing: Maximum flip/spot availability used by the comparison.

review.note: Supplied gamma flip relation is separate from regime inference; automatic engine stays null. Native identity/time joins are external.

contract.inputs: Source product/expiry, wall label/type/rank, native value or band, optional explicit mapping, snapshot.
contract.outputs: walls[] preserving label/rank/units, spot_relation, selected_wall_id, automatic_walls=null.
contract.timing: Verified source snapshot availability before selection/contact.

review.note: Retains multiple supplied ranked wall IDs and validates missing/duplicate IDs. Automatic walls stay null; source unit/expiry and selected-wall assembly remain external.

contract.inputs: Literal source label/value, native product/expiry, panel/version, snapshot and stated calculation convention if present.
contract.outputs: max_pain_value, source_known, relation_to_separate_walls, automatic_max_pain=null.
contract.timing: Actual snapshot availability.

review.note: Supplied max pain remains distinct from put-wall equality and terminal prediction. Automatic engine stays null; native identity/time assembly remains external.

contract.inputs: Literal label/value/unit, native product, panel/version, snapshot and stated interpretation.
contract.outputs: source_value, unit, interpretation?, automatic_value=null.
contract.timing: Verified snapshot availability.

review.note: Supplied value/unit required and automatic Vol Trigger is null. Missing field is collapsed to engine hole instead of the exact absent source_value/unit; interpretation metadata is omitted.

contract.inputs: Literal VOL-GEX label/value/unit, product/expiry, source panel/version, snapshot and interpretation.
contract.outputs: source_vol_gex, unit, interpretation?, automatic_value=null.
contract.timing: Actual snapshot availability.

review.note: Supplied VOL-GEX value/unit is retained with an automatic engine hole; source interpretation metadata is omitted.

contract.inputs: Gauge label/value/unit, native product, source panel/version, timestamp and stated interpretation.
contract.outputs: gauge_value, source_interpretation?, automatic_pressure=null.
contract.timing: Actual snapshot availability.

review.note: Supplied gauge/scale and interpretation retained; scale holes and no universal entry permission are explicit.

contract.inputs: KG1 literal level/band, provider/version, instrument/date, availability and role in selected source case.
contract.outputs: kg1_band, source_known, role, automatic_kg1=null.
contract.timing: Verified source availability before contact.

review.note: KG1 input is retained, but two_reason_ok is computed from KG1 plus HVN ID count; this cannot establish the independently required reaction-history plus HVN confluence described by the contract. KG1 identity alone is not a second reason.

contract.inputs: VIX observation/value/unit, publication time, source instrument/range context, event context and selected risk interpretation.
contract.outputs: available_vix, observation_at, source_context?, ambition_adjustment?.
contract.timing: Publication/availability, not merely observation date.

review.note: One supplied VIX publication is gated, but faithful_preopen is always true once a publication exists, even when it is later than use. Latest available observation/age and source risk interpretation are not assembled.

contract.inputs: Available VIX value in percentage points; optional explicitly selected contemporaneous conversion price P and instrument identity.
contract.outputs: daily_move_percent=VIX/sqrt(252), daily_fraction=VIX/(100*sqrt(252)), point_estimate=P*daily_fraction if mapped.
contract.timing: Maximum VIX and conversion-price availability.

review.note: Correct VIX/sqrt(252) percent and optional point conversion; the separately required daily_fraction output is absent. Source unit/price identity must remain attached.

objects.title: Volatility term structure and event change

contract.inputs: Named products/tenors, native values/units, synchronized availability, source curve/event interpretation.
contract.outputs: tenor_values[], difference_or_ratio_when_selected, event_change, source_curve_label?.
contract.timing: Latest required component availability; post-event change only after the post observation.

review.note: Literal tenor difference/ratio and a gated post-event change exist. Named tenor/unit records, supplied interpretation and max post-input availability are not carried through.

contract.inputs: VVIX native observation/unit, publication time, source interpretation and relation to selected volatility read.
contract.outputs: available_vvix, source_interpretation?, automatic_entry_rule=null.
contract.timing: Actual publication availability; date alone is insufficient.

review.note: Future availability is rejected, but missing availability still returns usable=true and an optional fallback known_at. Latest available observation/interpretation assembly is absent.

contract.inputs: Source session ID, verified formation [start, end), complete native H/L and instrument; selected traded/opposing boundary.
contract.outputs: box_high, box_low, box_width, formation_end, known_at, boundary_ids.
contract.timing: Formation end after coverage validation; never an earlier forming-range sweep.

review.note: Box geometry, source IDs and formation availability exist. Shares incomplete coverage proof with range_hl, accepts compact fixture H/L path without evidence-mode restriction, and does not enforce verified Asia/London/source clock configuration.

contract.inputs: Frozen reference L/H or line R, side, ordered prices, source confirmation type/timeframe, complete bar C when applicable, decision time.
contract.outputs: sweep_at, sweep_extreme, confirm_at, failure_confirmed?, reference_known_before_sweep.
contract.timing: Reference before sweep; sweep before confirmation; confirmation available at close before decision.

review.note: Does not enforce sweep_at<confirm_at, complete source confirmation bar/mode or box return against both edges. A witnessed non-sweep yields unknown rather than false. Method-level checks may reject some cases, but the object contract is not complete.

objects.title: Prior day, week and month extremes

contract.inputs: Period kind/calendar, full-session or RTH scope, complete prior period prices, source lookback and active-state rule.
contract.outputs: prior_high, prior_low, period_id, period_end, known_at, active_state?.
contract.timing: Prior period close plus required coverage; not current-period final extrema.

review.note: Accepts daily/weekly levels; no prior-period extrema builder, monthly output, period identity/end or retirement ledger. Weekly convention hole only applies if caller sets need_week.

contract.inputs: Instrument, ET session date, verified midnight opening trade or supplied source opening value, source role and optional required close-through mode.
contract.outputs: tdo_price, tdo_known_at, role, close_through_tdo?.
contract.timing: Opening event availability or completed input bar close.

review.note: Optional TDO role and source-required complete five-minute close are handled with explicit unknowns. Literal midnight trade extraction and dated identity remain an upstream producer task.

contract.inputs: Instrument, first source cash-open event, opening value, excursions/returns, source branch/confirmation.
contract.outputs: cash_open, known_at, cross_below_at, cross_above_at, source_open_reclaim?.
contract.timing: Opening event, then actual excursion/return evidence; confirmation at its own source key.

review.note: Scans all later supplied events without as_of clipping, omits crossing times and defaults output known_at to open_at. A later reclaim can therefore be backdated at the recipe boundary.

contract.inputs: Source Friday close F with exact close convention, Sunday opening S with exact convention, source week/instrument, preselected objective.
contract.outputs: gap_lo=min(F, S), gap_hi=max(F, S), gap_width=abs(S-F), known_at, partial_contact, full_fill.
contract.timing: Maximum endpoint availability, normally Sunday opening observation.

review.note: Supplied Friday/Sunday endpoint algebra, zero-gap handling and directional fill geometry work. Friday convention is required but separate Sunday convention/native endpoint availability are not validated here.

contract.inputs: Completed measured impulse ID, direction, high H/low L, endpoint confirmations and source selection, later touch.
contract.outputs: width W, band_lo, band_hi, known_at, linked_failure_id.
contract.timing: Maximum endpoint confirmation/selection key before band use.

review.note: Positive-width down/up retracement algebra is present. Parent confirmation, source selection and actual failure linkage must be assembled externally; no automatic impulse selector is claimed.

objects.title: Premium / discount within a selected range

contract.inputs: Selected parent range H/L or explicit VWAP/value reference, known_at, current price, author/branch.
contract.outputs: range_mid, normalized_position=(P-L)/(H-L), location:discount/equilibrium/premium; or separately labeled value-relative relation.
contract.timing: Maximum parent and current price availability.

review.note: Correct positive-width normalized position and distinct VWAP-relative comparison. Parent/source timing assembly remains external.

contract.inputs: Confirmed swing/boundary IDs, price and confirmation keys, prior failure ID, actual break/close event, linked gap and decision.
contract.outputs: structure_reference, structure_confirmation_at, mss_after_failure?, automatic_mss=null.
contract.timing: At actual boundary confirmation/break completion, not pivot price time.

review.note: Supplied MSS temporal order is checked; automatic detector stays null. Entry applicability must follow each source case, including the corrected November 20 sweep entry.

contract.inputs: Instrument/timeframe, defining complete candle IDs, explicit wick/body construction, bounds, confirmation, active/fill policy and entry/target role.
contract.outputs: gap_lo, gap_hi, gap_known_at, construction, active_at_use?, contact_or_fill?.
contract.timing: Last defining confirmation close; not the first candle's time.

review.note: Supplied gap geometry exists, but any edge is called far_edge regardless of direction, absent fill evidence becomes filled=false, and active policy is copied rather than evaluated. No supplied construction execution or lifecycle ledger.

contract.inputs: Source 2/3/5-minute complete candles C1/C2/C3, sweep side, chosen immediate/midpoint/retrace entry and source stop policy.
contract.outputs: ob_band=[L2, H2], ob_mid=(L2+H2)/2, confirmation_at, selected_entry_mode, selected_stop?.
contract.timing: C3 confirmation close for confirmed OB; C2 alone cannot confirm it.

review.note: Only bullish C2 low-sweep/C3-close-above pattern is implemented; documented bearish mirror is absent. Full C2 range is correct, but selected entry/stop policy fields and candle identity/completeness joins are absent.

contract.inputs: Completed source candle O/H/L/C, rejection side, timeframe, allowed location, source confirmation and chosen entry/stop geometry.
contract.outputs: body_lo=min(O, C), body_hi=max(O, C), rejection_band, wick_width, known_at, stop_policy?.
contract.timing: Candle close plus source confirmation/selection availability.

review.note: Upper/lower wick geometry and zero-width handling exist. Source rejection, selected entry/stop and allowed-location evidence remain external rather than being inferred from a wick.

contract.inputs: Complete source bar O/H/L/C/V, source timeframe, 14-period volume reference and exact inclusion/reset/warm-up convention, threshold equality convention.
contract.outputs: body_ratio=abs(C-O)/(H-L), volume_average, volume_ratio=V/average, small_body?, high_volume?, source_zone_flag?.
contract.timing: Current candle close and all baseline dependencies; future volume forbidden.

review.note: Correct printed 0.6 and 1.5 thresholds, but average divides by any supplied sample length rather than enforcing the documented 14 members/settings. Baseline inclusion/reset/availability and degenerate-candle invalidity are not fully enforced.

contract.inputs: Author, candidate/branch, source grade/reasons, relevant same-candidate sweep, grade availability and selected exposure.
contract.outputs: source_grade, necessary_grade_condition_ok?, unpublished_grade_fields[], grade_known_at.
contract.timing: Actual source grade/reason availability.

review.note: Preserves necessary sweep failure versus unknown sufficient A+ grading and early-attempt distinction. Source grade/size records remain external.

contract.inputs: Author/auction ID, selected bounds, scale/profile scope, prior two-sided acceptance evidence and known_at, later migration events.
contract.outputs: balance_band, balance_width, source_acceptance?, balance_active_at_use?, automatic_balance=null.
contract.timing: When bounds and acceptance evidence were available, not after the later reaction.

review.note: Supplied balance bounds, nonnegative width and declaration time are checked; acceptance evidence, active-state/migration record and full profile identity outputs are absent. Automatic selector remains a legitimate hole.

contract.inputs: Canonical executed events p_i/v_i, source profile interval/as_of, instrument tick q, explicit price-bin width/grid/membership convention.
contract.outputs: native_volume_by_price, source_bins[], total_volume, profile_id, coverage, as_of.
contract.timing: Latest included event availability after the declared profile interval, plus source selection availability.

review.note: Native supplied-trade histogram arithmetic exists, but source multi-bin grid, profile/window/coverage identity and automatic interval construction are incomplete; source histogram-only ingestion is not provided by the required trades path.

contract.inputs: Profile histogram, author/fraction f, source VA algorithm/contiguity/POC expansion/tie conventions or supplied VAL/VAH, fixed/developing identity.
